## Vocabulary

- **self**: Program IDs and account layouts with sources (15/5)

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Prefer the IDL bundled with the SDK or repo over an on-chain IDL. P0 says not to fetch MarginFi's IDL from chain because the on-chain IDL account is not kept current, Velocity says to decode against the SDK's velocity.json, and Anchor describes on-chain IDL storage as something the program author uploads (anchor idl init, via Program Metadata). (medium confidence) — https://docs.0.xyz/llms.mdx/typescript-sdk/program-upgrade-0-1-11 · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/concepts/account-model.md, https://www.anchor-lang.com/docs/basics/idl

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The mainnet MarginFi program (MFv2hWf31Z9kbCa1snEPYctwafyhdvnV7FZnsebVacA) flipped from 0.1.9 to 0.1.10 at 2026-08-25 15:00 UTC. Until then the SDK gated the 0.1.10 instruction layout on a per-program-id activation timestamp; the gate was removed once the upgrade was final, and the SDK now emits the 0.1.10 wire format unconditionally. (medium confidence) — https://docs.0.xyz/llms.mdx/typescript-sdk/program-upgrade · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://github.com/0dotxyz/p0-ts-sdk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Accounts are resized in place, so a dataSize filter rots. Velocity's extend_account grows zero-copy accounts (grow-only, idempotent, permissioned), and its docs say to decode length-tolerantly, never assert data.length equals the compiled size, and filter getProgramAccounts by the 8-byte discriminator with memcmp. MarginFi's 0.1.10 deploy resized MarginfiGroup and FeeState on chain, and its v1-sized FeeState cannot be loaded until resized. (high confidence) — https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/concepts/account-model.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://docs.0.xyz/llms.mdx/typescript-sdk/program-upgrade, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0dotxyz/marginfi-v2/main/type-crate/src/types/fee_state.rs
- [statement] Error 'AnchorError caused by account: group. AccountNotEnoughKeys' on a loop/swap or simulateBundle health simulation means a 0.1.9-style end_flashloan or pulse_health instruction reached a 0.1.10 program, which inserted required accounts (group, and fee_state for transfer_to_new_account) into six instructions; build with p0-ts-sdk 2.7.0 or later. (low confidence) — https://docs.0.xyz/llms.mdx/typescript-sdk/program-upgrade · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources

MarginFi's type-crate hardcodes the same kfarms and Scope IDs. (high confidence) — https://kamino.com/docs/build/resources/program-addresses.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0dotxyz/marginfi-v2/main/type-crate/src/pdas.rs, https://verify.osec.io/status/KvauGMspG5k6rtzrqqn7WNn3oZdyKqLKwK2XWQ8FLjd, https://verify.osec.io/status/FarmsPZpWu9i7Kky8tPN37rs2TpmMrAZrC7S7vJa91Hr, https://verify.osec.io/status/HFn8GnPADiny6XqUoWE8uRPPxb29ikn4yTuPa9MF2fWJ
- [statement] Velocity (the Drift v2 fork) program ID is vELoC1audYbSYVRXn1vPaV8Axoa9oU6BYmNGZZBDZ1P, the same string on devnet and mainnet-beta. The SDK keeps two constants, VELOCITY_PROGRAM_ID and VELOCITY_DEVNET_PROGRAM_ID, so the two can diverge without a code change. Velocity's docs, its monorepo README and Solana Compass's Drift profile all list this address. (high confidence) — https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/concepts/program-vault-addresses.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velocity-exchange/velocity-v1/master/README.md, https://solanacompass.com/projects/Drift
- [statement] The Velocity JIT proxy program ID is J1TPRoXCtGuMcWiWFE6RB9eZU8U35PBMETCwNQLCNPhQ; Velocity's README and its docs agree, and the docs say it is the same on both environments. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velocity-exchange/velocity-v1/master/README.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/concepts/program-vault-addresses.md
- [statement] Other Velocity-related program IDs rest on one page each: the vaults program vAuLTsyrvSfZRuRB3XgvkPwNGgYSs9YRYymVebLKoxR (README only), the oracle receiver G6EoTTTgpkNBtVXo96EQp2m6uwwVh2Kt6YidjkmQqoha and the Pyth Lazer program pytd2yyk641x7ak7mkaasSJVXh6YYZnC7wTmtgAyxPt (docs only, both carried by the SDK config). (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velocity-exchange/velocity-v1/master/README.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/concepts/program-vault-addresses.md
- [statement] The Jupiter Lend IDs above are for the main market only. The jupiter-lend README says the SDK's market parameter also selects an ethena market, which is a separate deployment with its own program IDs, and that the devnet programs in the CPI guides were last deployed in May 2025 and do not match the current IDLs. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jup-ag/jupiter-lend/main/README.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources
- [statement] Jupiter Swap v6 aggregator program ID is JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4: Jupiter's own jupiter-cpi crate declares it with declare_id! and generates its interface with anchor-gen from the Jupiter Anchor JSON IDL (idl.json), and Helius's parsed-data page for Jupiter Aggregator v6 lists the same ID. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jup-ag/jupiter-cpi/main/src/lib.rs · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://www.helius.dev/parsed-data/jupiter/aggregator-v6
- [statement] Jupiter says its Perps API is still a work in progress and sends integrators to the Perps program IDL on Solscan (the programIdl view) or to the community repo julianfssen/jupiter-perps-anchor-idl-parsing, which ships jupiter-perpetuals-idl.ts. The official account pages and the IDL can disagree, so treat the on-chain program as the final check. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://developers.jup.ag/docs/perps/index.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/perps/pool-account.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/julianfssen/jupiter-perps-anchor-idl-parsing/main/src/idl/jupiter-perpetuals-idl.ts
- [statement] Drift and Velocity share these PDA seeds (the u16 values are little-endian): user ["user", authority, subAccountId], user_stats ["user_stats", authority], perp_market ["perp_market", marketIndex], spot_market ["spot_market", marketIndex], plus spot_market_vault and insurance_fund_vault keyed by market index. The State seed differs: "drift_state" on Drift, "velocity_state" on Velocity. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drift-labs/protocol-v2/master/sdk/src/addresses/pda.ts · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velocity-exchange/velocity-v1/master/packages/sdk/src/addresses/pda.ts, https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/concepts/account-model.md
- [statement] A PDA depends on the program ID as well as the seeds. Velocity reuses Drift's seed strings under a new program ID, so every Drift-derived address is wrong on Velocity even where the seeds match; delete cached Drift addresses and re-derive them with the SDK helpers, which run offchain at no RPC cost. (high confidence) — https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/migrate-from-drift.md · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://docs.velocity.exchange/developers/concepts/program-vault-addresses.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velocity-exchange/velocity-v1/master/packages/sdk/src/addresses/pda.ts
- [statement] Kamino klend PDA seeds (identical in the Rust program and klend-sdk): "lma" with the lending market for the market authority, and "reserve_liq_supply", "fee_receiver", "reserve_coll_mint" and "reserve_coll_supply" per reserve, plus "user_meta", "referrer_acc", "ref_state" and "short_url" for user and referral accounts. (high confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kamino-Finance/klend/master/programs/klend/src/utils/seeds.rs · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kamino-Finance/klend-sdk/master/src/utils/seeds.ts
- [statement] MarginFi's type-crate encodes Jupiter Lend PDA seeds: "lending_admin" (lending program), "liquidity" and "auth_list" (liquidity program), "reserve" + mint, "rate_model" + mint, "f_token_mint" + mint (lending program), "lending" + mint + f_token_mint (lending program) and "user_supply_position" + mint + protocol (liquidity program). One source only. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0dotxyz/marginfi-v2/main/type-crate/src/pdas.rs · keywords: Program IDs and account layouts with sources
